priorities.label: S
priorities.description: Highest-impact or urgent work. Use when delay creates meaningful cost, blocks a release, or affects users now.

priorities.label: A
priorities.description: Important committed work. Use when humans and agents should plan or execute it soon.

priorities.label: B
priorities.description: Valuable planned work. Use when it matters, but can follow S and A priorities.

priorities.label: C
priorities.description: Normal operational work. Use for useful tasks without urgent timing or high leverage.

priorities.label: D
priorities.description: Low-priority maintenance or cleanup. Use when helpful, but easy to defer.

priorities.label: E
priorities.description: Backlog or someday work. Use when worth keeping, but not actively planned.

priorities.label: F
priorities.description: Lowest-priority or reference work. Use for parked, optional, or administrative tasks with no current pressure.

pipelines.name: Project
pipelines.description: Use this pipeline for outcome-based work with a clear deliverable. Brainstorming is for shaping rough ideas, Planned is for committed work, InProgress is for active execution, Paused is for blocked or intentionally deferred work, Finished is for completed deliverables, and Dropped is for work that was intentionally abandoned.
